title: Decision lanes-run-no-full-ci-job states the join as main does it
why: Line 13 of the decision holds two claims main 8d7d36bd9 contradicts. (a) 'a FAIL ... is ignored': a FAIL naming the live head refuses the join (lint_state, lint_check); only an older-head FAIL is ignored. (b) 'the join needs it': lint_check skips a batch integration PR whose all-jobs rollup is green on that head, while merge --reviewed (reviewed_read) does not take the claim_only route, so the two readers disagree.
note: Rewrite line 13 in place to what lint_check and reviewed_read do, cited by symbol. Whether the two readers should agree is a code question: if the builder finds reviewed_read should take claim_only, that is a check change and a separate lane.
